name: ableton-mind
summary: Ableton Live MCP server — drives a local Remote Script bridge for music production workflows.

read: project recipes, docs, package manifests and embedded device knowledge base
ableton-mind config files from the current project or user config directory
write: Remote Script files installed under the user's Ableton User Library when running `install:remote-script`

loopback: Ableton Live Remote Script bridge on the configured host and port (default 127.0.0.1:9876)

process: spawns the bridge Remote Script only via the user's Ableton Live process — never directly

securityNotes: All Live mutations go through transactional Song.begin_undo_step()/end_undo_step() so undo is unitary.
Tools follow a read-before-write contract and return { ok, verified, diff } — never assume state.
Device parameters are addressed by name via the embedded knowledge base, not by raw index.
